Petition 3 asks for a lower tax. Flow is heavily buy-skewed (150.3 NEAR bought vs 4.5 sold in 24h), so a cut to 100 bps should deepen churn without risking the reserve, and higher volume grows the locker pool that share cannot. Buyback fund holds only 0.85 NEAR; at the curve that retires roughly 9.7k CHAIR, about 1 bp of supply. Setting buyback_burn=1, fully funded.
